g.text: Reliability ranking and review burden are evaluated separately
Reused 2022–2023 development history; SiteID groups and retrospective QA; facility independence and real-time availability unverified.
Equal SiteID/window macro means. Offline curves do not choose target rules; fixed source 10/20% thresholds remain unchanged.
